scope: Synthetic local Git probe only; no Docker, model, credential or external remote operation; not application acceptance

checks.check: uncommitted change in A is absent from B
local commit in A is absent from independent B
publication into remote fixture does not update configured repo
publication also does not update already created B
fresh authorized source contains published commit
object existing only without an advertised head is not guaranteed in next clone
independent downstream reads exact published result without worktree sharing
tree identifier cannot be supplied as commit SHA
choosing one predecessor commit does not combine another predecessor result
